I, on November 1st at 07:39 Beijing time, sincerely apologize to the great BLG Esports Club. I shouldn't have said such base, shameless, and ignorant things in my dorm around 23:30 last night like, 'This [~0:f***ing team] better swim back and filter sea water,' or 'As long as they last fifty minutes in two games I won't flame them'
Bin, you are the [~1:best top laner in the world], the master of vertical short dramas, the eternal number 1. You're the most team-oriented, highest-impact, most masterful top laner who can break open side lanes. I thank you for your 2024 MSI Camille and 2026 First Stand Jax; without you, the LPL would [~2:f***ing disband]
Xun, you're the jungler with the most tactical vision. I shouldn't have doubted your reluctance to gank top; turns out you were just acting to send HLE to the 16th place. I thank you for your Pantheon today and your Kindred at MSI. Without you, the game couldn't even start—wait, no, without your shotcalling, these guys' brains probably would've exploded
I don't need to apologize to Knight, since I never flamed him anyway. BLG's bedrock carry, nothing more to say, he's always been my daddy
Viper, you're the ADC who deals the most damage. Game 1 you got six kills and zero deaths to show your survival skills, and in Game 2 while everyone else was running wild you took zero kills to display a spirit of selfless dedication. I shouldn't have said your Feng was taking off yesterday—permission to return to base!!
ON, you're the support with the most inspiration. Even though you had zero presence today, the sense of security your Lulu gave us in Game 2 was basically like wearing a condom. I shouldn't have called you Ge Wenjun yesterday, but you really need to keep it steady and remember the alarm bells of the year before last
Finally, please allow me to apologize to BLG, I'm sorry
Daeny, you [~3:f***ing] better draft properly

〖也就是说———没错，是BLG赢了〗。旁白：最强的上下路（HLE）,铭刻于十六强
top.en:
Within the 41 seconds before the Realm of a Thousand Demons was unleashed, the chant of BLG echoed through the river once again: "Polymorph", "Nirvana Palm", "Great Desolate Falling Star", "Ragnarok". HLE realized they could no longer stop the birth of the Realm of a Thousand Demons teamwipe. Unrestricted executions lit up the sky above the river like a nuclear blast, carving new battle scars into the terrain. The dragon's HP vanished into thin air amidst Pantheon's Smite. Amidst the ruins, a desperately defending Zeus leaned limply against a shattered building to support his body. A similarly battered Bin appeared in front of Zeus, and Zeus immediately forced himself off the wall, standing tall and proud right in front of Bin. Now, Bin used Death's Dance to recover his basic attack output efficiency, while Zeus had decreased healing and had successively lost Gumayusi and Zeka. If he couldn't break through Bin's Thornmail now, he'd have to rely on basic attacks hand-to-hand to brawl with him. Daeny's voice carried unconcealable ecstasy, and BLC stared blankly at the screen, still refusing to believe it.
[That is to say ——— that's right, BLG won]. Narrator: The strongest top and bot (HLE), engraved in the top 16.

top.zh:
终局灯亮，BLG战胜HLE挺进八强✨
这场胜利，藏着太多不能输的理由。
 
忘不了24年芮尔留下的意难平，近在咫尺却擦肩而过；
忘不了25年身为一号种子，遗憾止步16强的窒息。
 
26年有先锋赛登顶的高光，也有沙特杯、MSI接连折戟的落寞。
起起落落之间，看清了赛场的人情冷暖：鲜花永远涌向胜者，低谷总是人走茶凉。
 
有人来了又走，但总有人默默坚守。
我始终觉得：没能在低谷时并肩，就不配在顶峰说热爱。
 
下一轮对阵DK，又是一场硬仗。
带着24年未完成的遗憾往前走吧，放下包袱，放手去打。
那些不甘与蛰伏，都该在峡谷里化作锋芒。
 
加油BLG，去把意难平，写成圆满。
top.en:
The final light turns on, BLG defeats HLE and advances to the quarterfinals✨
This victory holds too many reasons why they couldn't afford to lose. Can't forget the lingering regret left by Rell in '24, slipping away when it was right within reach;
Can't forget the suffocating exit in '25 as the first seed crashing out in the Swiss stage. '26 brought the highs of winning First Stand, but also the sorrow of consecutive stumbles at the Esports World Cup and MSI.
Amidst the ups and downs, you see the fickle warmth of the esports scene: flowers always flock to the victor, and when you hit rock bottom people [~0:turn their backs and leave]. Some come and go, but there are always those who silently stand their ground.
I've always felt: if you can't stand shoulder-to-shoulder in the valley, you don't deserve to talk about passion at the peak. Next round against DK, another tough battle.
Carry forward the unfinished regrets of '24, drop the baggage and swing freely.
All that frustration and dormant grit should turn into sharp blades on the Rift. Let's go BLG, go turn those regrets into a happy ending.

top.en: There's really no helping you, so sit tight. Within the 41 seconds before the match started, the chant of Chen Zebin echoed through Alan City once again. "Steelskin", "Sun God", "Best Top Laner in the World", "LPL 2nd Seed"—Zeus realized he no longer had any chance to stop Bin's revenge. Olaf activated his ultimate, blazing with a nuclear-blast-like light that lit up the skies of Alan City. Gumayusi's Caitlyn vanished into ashes amidst Ragnarok. Inside the dragon pit, Zeus tried his absolute best to protect himself, leaning powerlessly against the broken pit wall as his left arm and thigh were completely devoured by that single strike. A similarly battered Chen Zebin appeared before Zeus. Zeus immediately forced himself off the wall, standing tall and proud in front of Chen Zebin. However, affected by his teammates nearby, the damage Chen Zebin received was greatly mitigated. Protected by the Mountain Dragon Soul, Chen Zebin's body regenerated. To Chen Zebin, that decisive strike of Ragnarok was merely an impromptu creation; the result was Caitlyn getting instantly vaporized. "Looks like that went well enough." Who could have expected that Karma and Zeus frantically trying to stop him was just Chen Zebin's simple flank? In a mere 41 seconds before the teamfight broke out, Chen Zebin adapted on the fly and pulled off multiple textbook flanking gods descending from heaven. ON stared blankly at the screen in disbelief: "That is to say...", "That's right, Chen Zebin wins, BLG wins!" The title of the strongest top laner is forever etched into Alan City.

After failing at Worlds, many will gradually forget that you still had many highlight moments this year, but that's just how competitive sports are, especially esports—you have to win forever. Two years ago, when you left T1, I believed you would carve out your own path, and you really were the best top laner after leaving T1. It's just a pity that these two years at Worlds have been fruitless. After working hard for a whole year, this ending is really hard to accept, not to mention a label like '16th place' that will stick with you for a lifetime... But there's no way around it, failure runs through the entirety of life. As your fan, I still believe that at least for the next few years, you will be one of the best top laners in the world. There's still hope for a title next year. Even someone as strong as Faker had to wait many years to ascend to godhood again. You are still young and can afford to wait. Keep going, let's return to this stage next year.

Do you recall the old mid laner who carried you out of the Swiss stage with god-like performance and zero mistakes when you were dying infinitely? When teammates couldn't step up, did you remember that game-changing Sylas? The Galio that descended from the sky when Xayah was dying? I miss the 2023 low point when you told Ruler you'd crush him to avenge Faker's S7, 2024 saying you'd use Xayah to crush all Kai'Sa in the LPL, and 2025 when Faker made a mistake and hit a wall, Gumayusi hugged and comforted him. The three stars are for our beautiful three-peat times. Faker never says 'it's Faker's era now'. In 2023, he said the 4th title was for his teammates. top.zh:
HLE.Delight 退役公告

Hanwha Life Esports 英雄联盟分部在此正式宣布，辅助选手 Delight（柳焕中 / 유환중） 决定结束自己的职业选手生涯，正式退役。

自2024年加入HLE以来，Delight陪伴队伍走过无数赛场征程。从LCK联赛、MSI到全球总决赛，他以精准的开团、冷静的视野把控，一次次在团战里扛起辅助位的责任，和队友一起拿下联赛冠军、站上国际赛事舞台。在Gen.G与HLE的职业生涯里，他留下了许多让人印象深刻的对局，也曾入选LCK最佳阵容，是LCK极具代表性的硬辅选手之一。

长久高压的职业旅途里，他坚持热爱、不断打磨自己，尝试软辅与硬辅的平衡，直面外界的评价与质疑。经过慎重长久的思考，他选择停下职业选手的脚步，开启人生新的篇章。

感谢Delight所有时间里的全力以赴，感谢他为HLE付出的一切，感谢他带给观众的所有高光时刻。我们尊重他的决定，俱乐部会给予他全力支持。
愿前路坦荡，褪去队服之后，依旧闪闪发光。Delight，辛苦了。

top.en: Congratulations to BLG for defeating HLE in the recently concluded [~0:Swiss stage] match and successfully advancing to the 2026 World Championship quarterfinals. We know many of you stayed up with us through the tense and grueling matches; we received every single cheer. This hard-won victory is dedicated to every Summoner who waited until the end. We won't treat this victory as the finish line. The opponents in the quarterfinals are not to be underestimated, and the road ahead is still full of challenges. We are very happy that we can carry everyone's expectations and continue moving forward. Thank you to everyone who firmly supports BLG. The story continues, and we will carry this recognition and give it our all in the quarterfinals!

notes.context: The Swiss stage format used in the Worlds tournament.

HLE should have absolutely no chance of winning Worlds [~0:Worlds] this year. Even though they won this game, it's obvious that Gumayusi is completely falling behind the intensity of Worlds now. He doesn't play playmaking champions, he only plays hypercarries to coast off his star teammates. The biggest issue is that his hypercarries throw the game so easily, and on top of throwing easily, he never builds Cleanse or Mercurial Scimitar. His Ezreal this game and his Kalista against IG were both like this. This means HLE can build leads through early-game tempo, but you never know which random play Gumayusi will throw and lose the match.
On top of that, HLE's wins this year always rely on their top, jungle, and mid. They have no early game advantage, and Gumayusi loses lane while loving to throw. I genuinely don't know how they're supposed to win.

notes.context: Refers to the League of Legends World Championship.

top.zh:
Bin 的纳尔身形忽大忽小，回旋镖在指尖转着。对面 Zeus 操控兰博，喷射器的火焰明明灭灭，热浪漫过整条上路。

她抬眼望他，语调轻软：“等兵线进塔，我就要烤你了。”
Bin 喉结滚动，庞大的兽爪悬在半空，迟迟没有拍下。“我也会推掉你的防御塔。”

他们都清楚，这局是生死对局。
火焰灼烧着纳尔的皮毛，他挥出重拳时，避开了她最要害的位置。兰博的火浪收了力道，留给他一丝喘息。

峡谷的风掠过，输赢摆在眼前。
“赛后，还能再说句话吗？” 她低声问。
Bin 没有应声，只握紧回旋镖 —— 赛场之上，偏爱从来都要让给胜负。

top.en:
Bin's Gnar shifted in size, the boomerang spinning at his fingertips. Opposite him, Zeus operated Rumble, the flamethrower's flames flickering on and off as heat waves washed across the entire top lane. She looked up at him, her tone soft and light: "Once the minion wave pushes into the tower, I'm going to roast you."
Bin's Adam's apple bobbed, his massive beast paws hovering in mid-air, failing to slam down for the longest time. "I'll push down your turret too." They both knew this match was a life-or-death showdown.
Flames scorched Gnar's fur, and when he lashed out with a heavy punch, he avoided her most vital spots. Rumble's fire waves held back their force, leaving him a sliver of breathing room. The canyon wind swept past, victory and defeat laid bare before their eyes.
"After the match, can we say another word?" she asked in a low voice.
Bin did not reply, only tightening his grip on the boomerang—on the competitive stage, favoritism must always yield to victory and defeat.
